'''Lunava''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[New Misos]], a two-time [[FLLA World Cup]] champion ([[1740 FLLA World Cup|1740]] and [[1748 FLLA World Cup|1748]]) and the fourteenth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city is home to the '''Lunava Federal Museum''', which has displayed in perpetuity '''[[The Vulna]]''', the permanent trophy of the [[1740 FLLA World Cup]] and the inaugural permanent trophy of the FLLA's two-trophy system, since the closing ceremony of the 1740 tournament on 2 July 1740.

Lunava hosted the [[1748 FLLA World Cup]] final, in which the home side [[New Misos]] defeated [[Seytinemas]] 4–3 in a match widely described in subsequent FLLA literature as the "Greatest World Cup Final in History". The city also displays '''The Marsen''', the permanent trophy of the [[1748 FLLA World Cup]], at the same museum.
